title: Consume European battle OBJ support fields
changes: Extend E208-d207 OBJ static resources with seven independently rooted IWRAM callback words and four additional actor lookup entries while preserving prior fields, source ownership, original guest indexing and mutable guest code.
Authenticate each selected original literal, pointer load, branch bridge and copied-code prefix; keep the neighboring 397fb4 word raw pending a source-backed consumer.
validation: Windows test build gn2scklt and Wine _pxxvoql pass all 36 source bytes, poisoned mixed boundaries and mirrors, 122 preserved resources, 14 original interpreter/generated callback cases, 22 original lookup cases and snapshot-owner retention.

Wine sk5simea compares 600 recorded EUR Llednar frames with selected ROM backing altered: state, guest clock, video, OAM, dispatch and five nonempty audio streams match. It serves 28 additional actor bytes and 80/372 bytes from the two observed callback words.

Windows production build rihbwg96 and Wine CLI ayi5qr7q pass create, reuse and verify with 124 matching files. Reclassification rvzvbu0u leaves 3841 previously unowned sampled bytes, including 13 high.
limitations: The recorded battle lookup counter is aggregate; the earlier address audit sampled all four added entries. The earlier save ancestry is unknown; no new cheat or state forcing was used. Other callbacks, the neighboring word, actor indices, scenes, real-BIOS and UI save/Load remain open.
Linux, USA and native Windows require separate verification. Wine servers drained and the local Bluetooth overlay avoided the known assertion. No performance comparison was made.
